name: Pioneer AI
description: Pioneer fine-tunes, evaluates, and deploys small language models. Agents can call the REST API to generate synthetic data, train models, run inference, and run evaluations.

skills.name: Run inference
skills.description: Run NER, classification, or text generation on a Pioneer model - native, OpenAI-compatible, or Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

skills.name: Fine-tune a model
skills.description: Fine-tune a GLiNER or decoder model on a labeled dataset and monitor training until the model is ready for inference.

skills.name: Generate synthetic training data
skills.description: Generate synthetic NER, classification, or decoder training data with Pioneer's Felix engine, then use the dataset to start a fine-tuning job.

skills.name: Evaluate a model
skills.description: Evaluate a trained Pioneer model against a dataset and compare results against baseline LLMs.
